def split_csv(line):
    """Split a single CSV line into fields.

    Fields may be wrapped in double quotes; inside quotes a comma is literal and a
    doubled quote (""") stands for one quote character. The surrounding quotes are
    not part of the field's value.
    """
    fields = []
    field = []
    in_quotes = False
    at_field_start = True
    i = 0
    n = len(line)
    while i < n:
        ch = line[i]
        if in_quotes:
            if ch == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                    field.append('"')
                    i += 1
                else:
                    in_quotes = False
            else:
                field.append(ch)
        elif ch == ',':
            fields.append(''.join(field))
            field = []
            at_field_start = True
        elif ch == '"' and at_field_start:
            in_quotes = True
            at_field_start = False
        else:
            field.append(ch)
            at_field_start = False
        i += 1
    fields.append(''.join(field))
    return fields
